eye_line.note: At least 54% up from the bottom (official: eyes ≥256px up on a 472px-tall photo). No maximum is published; SpecShot aims below 68% so the top of the head keeps the required 3–5 mm gap below the top edge.

rules: Print: 33 mm wide × 48 mm high; head 28–33 mm from chin to crown and 15–22 mm wide
Leave 3–5 mm between the top of the head and the top edge, and at least 7 mm between the chin and the bottom edge
Digital upload: JPEG, 40–120 KB, between 354 × 472 px and 420 × 560 px
White or near-white background, with no border
Neutral expression, eyes open, mouth closed, ears visible; head tilt no more than 20° sideways or 25° up/down
No hats or head coverings except for religious reasons, and they must not hide any facial features
Glasses only if the lenses aren't tinted and there's no glare or frame across the eyes
research_notes: Print photo: 33mm wide x 48mm high, head width 15-22mm, head height (chin to crown) 28-33mm, space from crown to top edge 3-5mm, space from chin to bottom edge >=7mm — all confirmed directly from an official MFA-published PDF (visaforchina.cn) on 2026-09-13, which also resolved a real ambiguity: some secondary sites quote this as '48x33mm' (implying landscape), but the source's own diagram shows 33mm as width and 48mm as height (portrait) — used correctly here.

EYE-LINE: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED, A GENUINE FIRST for this library. The source states the vertical distance from the bottom edge to the eye line must be >=256 pixels on a 472px-tall reference photo — that's a confirmed MINIMUM of 54% from the bottom. No maximum is stated, so 85% above is an unconfirmed, non-rejecting ceiling, not a sourced number.
Digital upload: JPEG, 40-120KB file size (confirmed exactly), dimensions between 354x472px and 420x560px. SpecShot targets 383x557px, inside that confirmed range.
Background should be white or close to white, no border
Neutral expression, eyes open, mouth closed, ears visible; head tilt <=20 degrees left/right, <=25 degrees up/down
No head coverings except for religious reasons; glasses allowed only if lenses aren't tinted and don't glare/obscure the eyes
Photo must be recent, taken within 6 months
Source document is dated 2016 by its own copyright line but remains the current document linked from the live official visa portal as of this check.

2026-10-02: re-read the MFA poster PDF at source_url directly. Every figure in rules matches. Eye-line max 68 is derived (head ~30.5mm, eyes ~45-50% of head height below crown, crown 3-5mm from top => eyes ~60-63% from bottom), not published; labelled as such via eye_line.note.
